description: The Soul Agent Platform minimum contract error codes. Add-only: never remove, renumber, or change the meaning of a code; mark a retired one deprecated. A code is registered here before any implementation emits it. retryable and raised_by are WP1 curation, accepted 2026-11-07, where the paper is silent (schemas/README.md, Curation notes).

source.document: Soul Agent Platform, whitepaper draft 0.4 (2026-10-27), Minimum error codes

codes.description: The peer's contract version is outside the supported N and N-1 window (T14).
A frame requires a capability the receiver has not negotiated.
The authenticated caller does not match the claimed runtime or handle binding (T01).
A commit carries an installation epoch older than the authoritative current one.
The runtime execution lease has expired; protected commits stop until a new lease is acquired.
Authority was revoked; consume, wake, and execution refuse it (T08).
The destination is not approved for this task's data restrictions (T09).
The ceiling or sub-allocation is spent; new protected spend refuses (T26).
Compare-and-swap on the expected task revision failed; retry with the fresh revision.
A message ID was reused with different content; the message is quarantined.
Backpressure at the mailbox capacity limit; accepted work is never silently dropped (T18).
The frame exceeds the inline size limit; use an authorized content reference.
A queued message passed its expiry and is purged, not treated as new work (T25).
The message or Soul is quarantined (poison threshold, conflict, or crash loop) until the cause is resolved (T23).
Hello presented a definition digest that is not an accepted revision.
Completion criteria require evidence that was not supplied; supply it and retry.
The proposed action no longer matches its approval record digest (T24).
A task's write scope overlaps an active one without owner-allowed concurrent writers.
An external effect's outcome is ambiguous; reconcile through lookup, never blind replay (T06).
Candidate acceptance lacks a passing cell for a (role, harness version) pair (T27).
The whole candidate was rejected on a failed cell; a narrowed candidate may be re-evaluated (T28).
A non-optional primitive could not be rendered for an adapter; the failure names the class. Retryability depends on the named class.
A proposal derived from peer or external-untrusted content waits for owner approval of its source chain (T30).
A dream run breached its wall-clock or maintenance limit; no candidate is emitted (T29).
The identity service is unreachable; protected effects that need a fresh credential wait and retry when it returns.
The device is revoked; cached tokens are dropped and recovery requires new enrollment.
A protected claim was made under a weaker enforcement profile (T21).
